## Description
 If BaO is available directly, step 1 is skipped and the equation simplifies to BaO + 6 Fe₂O₃ → BaFe₁₂O₁₉.&#10;&#9;&#9;The entire process is a single high-temperature firing — no solvents, no acids, no multi-stage extraction. &#10;&#9;&#9;Ferrite is realistically manufacturable in-situ.&#10;&#9;&#9;&#10;&#9;&#9;Produce Barium Hexaferrite&#10;&#9;&#9;
